'''Toxico''' was the chemical company active during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]]. It was responsible for the production of a toxin called [[Cyanoxis D-587]] that was designed to exterminate [[Conduit worm/Legends|conduit worms]], a type of vermin that fed on electical systems. Toxico placed adverts for the chemical in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] that were published just before the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[23 BBY/Legends|23]] and [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Advertising for Cyanoxis D-587 appeared in [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]], an [[in-universe]] website created to publicize the upcoming film {{Film|II}}.
